facts.fact: April 在公路下方涵洞——四个副手盯着路缘下方的水。
facts.anchor: four deputies clustered at the edge of the roadway

facts.fact: Alex 判断：她在下面——Lacey 抬脚像踩着 April 的头。
Jackie 发现：巡查水道时注意到路肩被「咬烂」——轮胎压痕；水从路下流过。
facts.anchor: I noticed that the shoulder was kinda chewed up.

facts.fact: 副手拒绝下去——「你自己去看看」；Lacey 没有脊椎。
facts.anchor: Go and have a look yourself

facts.fact: Alex 脱外套交给 Lacey、命令封路设警戒线（Dana Garcia 也要来）。
涵洞参数：小腿深八英寸、开口不到四英尺高——弯腰进。
facts.anchor: The opening was no higher than four feet, and less across.

facts.fact: 触到颅骨的硬弧度——确认是 April；平躺、水刚好漫过口鼻。
facts.anchor: touched the hard curve of a cranium

facts.fact: 黑暗前理解：和 Rebecca 一样——April 被绑在椅子上；额头撞碎她的指节、手电漂走。
facts.anchor: April Gallagher was tied to a chair.
